Version 1.0.6 Changelog:

- Major update: Skill logic and documentation reworked to eliminate all explicit user identity (open-id) handling.
- Skill now performs all identity management internally; users are never prompted for usernames, phone numbers, or identifiers.
- All historical report queries and safety analysis actions occur using background system credentials.
- SKILL.md fully revised: streamlined, with a clearer structure, new demo section, and updated usage guidelines.
- Forbidden: displaying or requesting user identity parameters; only analysis status, results, and report links are user-facing.
- Internal workflow, parameter handling, and constraints are now described for easier integration and privacy compliance.

Major update: Migrated analysis logic to a new skill module and refactored supporting files.

- Migrated all infant safety analysis code from the deprecated face_analysis module to a dedicated smyx_analysis skill directory.
- Added new scripts and configuration files under skills/smyx_analysis/ for improved modularity and maintainability.
- Removed the now-obsolete face_analysis skill and all related files.
- Updated requirements and import paths to match the new module structure.
- Improved code organization in common scripts to support the refactored skill workflow.

- Updated version to 1.0.4 in SKILL.md and associated files.
- Clarified: attachments from users are now automatically saved as local files (previously specified directory removed).
- Improved: instructions for displaying historical report lists now specify extracting hyperlinks from API JSON responses, and formatting output as a markdown table.
- Refined: documentation details and wording for better accuracy and consistency.

- Improved configuration structure across dev, test, and production environments in scripts/config*.yaml.
- Enhanced open-id retrieval logic in scripts/config.py for stricter compliance with prioritized config sources.
- Updated utility functions in scripts/util.py for more robust file and configuration handling.
- Minor adjustments to __init__.py to support new configuration workflow.
- No changes to the user-facing SKILL.md usage or feature set.

- Improved reliability of open-id retrieval by refining the search logic in config files.
- Enhanced compatibility and import handling between face_analysis and common skill modules.
- Minor bug fixes and code cleanup for more stable skill execution.

- Updated version info and metadata in SKILL.md.
- No user-facing feature or logic changes are described in the documentation or code listing.
- General maintenance update for documentation consistency.

Initial release of the infant safety monitoring analysis skill.

- Enables real-time analysis of infant behavior in videos, identifying high-risk actions such as rolling over, mouth/nose obstruction, climbing, fence crossing, and falling from bed, and triggers instant safety warnings.
- Provides automated safety care reports and recommendations based on monitored video content.
- Strictly enforces that all historical report queries fetch data from the cloud API, never from local files or memory.
- Requires an open-id fetched via multi-step priority rules before running any analysis or report query.
- Output of historical report lists uses a markdown table, with each report providing direct links to full analysis results.
